explore-gauge.title: Pick the wire
explore-gauge.prompt: Choose the thinnest wire that keeps the loss within 0.5 V.
hints: Count 6 m of wire: there and back.
Number 12 loses 0.66 V. Try one size heavier.
explore-gauge.success: Number 10 loses 0.42 V over the 6 m round trip. Number 8 would work too, but it's heavier than needed.

explore-fuse.title: Where does the fuse go?
explore-fuse.prompt: Put the fuse where it protects the whole run of wire.
explore-fuse.success: At the battery, the fuse protects every centimetre of the positive lead.

explore-supply.title: Choose a supply
explore-supply.prompt: Choose the supply least likely to put RF noise into your receiver that also won't make your CW chirp.
explore-supply.success: The linear supply: regulated, so no chirp, and no switching noise. The switching one is smaller and lighter, though.
